```{python}
# | label: drive-distance-setup

import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from pathlib import Path
import sys

sys.path.insert(0, ".")
import _validation_scripts as vs

repo_root = Path("..")
calib_runs = vs.list_available_runs(repo_root)

# static reference / shared observed path (not run-specific) -- per-run
# in_rider_summary (carries a Cube-generated `___{runId}___` filename prefix --
# see 3-modechoice.qmd's note) is resolved inside the per-run loader below,
# against each run's own outputs_dir
config_paths = {
    "in_obs_processed": r"../inputs/UTA_OBS_2024_Linked_FactorAdjusted.csv",
}
```

```{python}
# | label: drive-obs-process

df_crt_access = (
    pd.read_csv(config_paths["in_obs_processed"], low_memory=False)
    # 1. Filter for CRT trips accessed by Drive OR Walk
    .query("FirstMode == 'CRT'")
    # 2. Assign the raw boarding address based on PA/AP direction
    .assign(
        STOP_ADDR=lambda x: np.where(
            x["PA_AP"] == "PA", x["STOP_ON_ADDR"], x["STOP_OFF_ADDR"]
        )
    )
    # 3. Extract the clean Stop_Name using your station list
    .assign(
        Stop_Name=lambda x: x["STOP_ADDR"].str.extract(
            f"({'|'.join(df_station_master['UTA_Stops'])})", expand=False
        )
    )
)

# Filter out rows with missing stop names or distances for a clean plot
df_plot = df_crt_access.dropna(subset=["Stop_Name", "boarding_weight"])
```

```{python}
# | label: crt-model-process

# Read, Filter, and Process Modeled Data (one calibration run at a time) --
# see report/preprocess/modelresults.py (extracted so this parsing happens
# once per tdmcalib run/import, not on every `quarto render`; see
# report/README.md's "Report data caching" section).
df_model_plot = vs.load_cached_per_run(repo_root, "crt_model")

# 3. Export Both Datasets to OJS
ojs_define(
    crt_plot_data=df_plot[
        ["Stop_Name", "access_dist", "access_time", "boarding_weight", "Ac_Mode2_Model"]
    ],
    crt_model_data=df_model_plot,
    station_list=df_station_master["UTA_Stops"].tolist(),
)
```

```{python}
# | label: debug-crt-access-validation
# | eval: true
# | echo: false

# ==============================================================================
# DEBUG: VALIDATE CRT ACCESS COUNTS (OBSERVED VS MODELED)
# ==============================================================================
print("--- STARTING CRT ACCESS VALIDATION ---\n")

# 1. Define Station Map (Model Node -> Station Name)
station_map = {
    50024: "Provo Central Station",
    50029: "Orem Central Station",
    50030: "Vineyard Station",
    50035: "American Fork Station",
    50040: "Lehi Station",
    10008: "Draper Station",
    10010: "South Jordan Station",
    10016: "Murray Central Station",
    10019: "Salt Lake Central Station",
    10021: "North Temple Station",
    10025: "Woods Cross Station",
    10031: "Farmington Station",
    10035: "Layton Station",
    10036: "Clearfield Station",
    10042: "Roy Station",
    10046: "Ogden Central Station",
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# A. ANALYZE OBSERVED DATA
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
print(f"Loading Observed Data from: {config_paths['in_obs_processed']}")
df_obs_debug = pd.read_csv(config_paths["in_obs_processed"], low_memory=False)

# Filter: First Mode is CRT (Access trips only, no transfers)
obs_crt_debug = df_obs_debug[df_obs_debug["FirstMode"] == "CRT"].copy()

# Map Station Names (PA/AP Logic)
obs_crt_debug["STOP_ADDR"] = np.where(
    obs_crt_debug["PA_AP"] == "PA",
    obs_crt_debug["STOP_ON_ADDR"],
    obs_crt_debug["STOP_OFF_ADDR"],
)
obs_crt_debug["Station"] = obs_crt_debug["STOP_ADDR"].str.extract(
    f"({'|'.join(station_map.values())})", expand=False
)

# Group by Mode and Station
print("\n>>> OBSERVED: Total Boardings by Access Mode")
print(obs_crt_debug.groupby("Ac_Mode2_Model")["boarding_weight"].sum().round(1))

print("\n>>> OBSERVED: Boardings by Station & Mode")
obs_station_stats = (
    obs_crt_debug.groupby(["Station", "Ac_Mode2_Model"])["boarding_weight"]
    .sum()
    .unstack(fill_value=0)
    .round(1)
)
# Show only relevant columns if they exist
cols_to_show = [c for c in ["Walk", "Bike", "Drive"] if c in obs_station_stats.columns]
print(obs_station_stats[cols_to_show])


# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# B. ANALYZE MODELED DATA (one calibration run at a time)
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
for _calib_run in calib_runs:
    _outputs_dir = vs.resolve_latest_run_outputs(repo_root, _calib_run)
    _in_rider_summary = vs.find_one(_outputs_dir, "*transit_rider_summary_link.csv")
    print(f"\nLoading Modeled Data ({_calib_run}) from: {_in_rider_summary}")
    df_model_debug = pd.read_csv(_in_rider_summary)

    # Filter: Mode 11/12 (Walk), 80 (Drive); Centroid (A<10000) -> Station (B in map)
    model_crt_debug = df_model_debug[
        (df_model_debug["Mode"].isin([11, 12, 80]))
        & (df_model_debug["A"] < 10000)
        & (df_model_debug["B"].isin(station_map.keys()))
    ].copy()

    # Map Columns
    model_crt_debug["Station"] = model_crt_debug["B"].map(station_map)
    model_crt_debug["Access_Mode"] = model_crt_debug["Mode"].map(
        {11: "Walk", 12: "Walk", 80: "Drive"}
    )

    # Group by Mode and Station
    print(f"\n>>> MODELED ({_calib_run}): Total Boardings by Access Mode")
    print(model_crt_debug.groupby("Access_Mode")["FromSkim_CRT"].sum().round(1))

    print(f"\n>>> MODELED ({_calib_run}): Boardings by Station & Mode")
    model_station_stats = (
        model_crt_debug.groupby(["Station", "Access_Mode"])["FromSkim_CRT"]
        .sum()
        .unstack(fill_value=0)
        .round(1)
    )
    print(model_station_stats)

print("\n--- VALIDATION COMPLETE ---")
```

```{ojs}
//| panel: input

// 2. Define Inputs with Custom Layout
viewof modeInput = Inputs.select(["Drive", "Walk"], {label: "Access Mode", value: "Drive"});
viewof metricInput = Inputs.select(["Access Distance (mi)", "Access Time (min)"], {label: "Metric", value: "Access Distance (mi)"});
viewof layersInput = Inputs.checkbox(["Observed", "Modeled"], {label: "Show Data:", value: ["Observed", "Modeled"]});
```

```{ojs}
//| label: merged-violin-plot

// 1. Prepare Data
dataObs = transpose(crt_plot_data)
dataMod = transpose(crt_model_data).filter(d => d.calib_run === globalCalibRun)

// 2. Reactive Filtering
metricInfo = metricInput === "Access Distance (mi)"
  ? { col: "access_dist", label: "Distance (miles)", max: 10 }
  : { col: "access_time", label: "Time (minutes)", max: 30 };

filteredObs = dataObs.filter(d => d.Ac_Mode2_Model === modeInput);
filteredMod = dataMod.filter(d => d.Ac_Mode2_Model === modeInput);

// Calculate dynamic max domain
domainMax = Math.max(
  d3.max(filteredObs, d => d[metricInfo.col]) || 0,
  d3.max(filteredMod, d => d[metricInfo.col]) || 0
) * 1.05;

// 3. Render Merged Plot
Plot.plot({
  height: 900,
  marginLeft: 160,
  marginTop: 40,
  style: { fontFamily: "Inter, sans-serif", fontSize: "13px", color: "#374151" },

  x: {
    label: metricInfo.label,
    labelOffset: 40,
    domain: [0, domainMax],
    grid: true,
    tickSize: 0,
    line: true
  },

  fy: {
    label: null,
    domain: station_list,
    padding: 0.1,
    tickFormat: d => d.replace(" Station", "")
  },

  y: {
    axis: "right",          // Move axis to the right side
    label: "Weighted Count", // Label what the height represents
    grid: true,             // Add horizontal grid lines to help compare peaks
    tickFormat: "s"         // Short format (e.g., 200, 1.5k) to save space
  },

  color: {
    domain: ["Observed", "Modeled"],
    range: ["#77933c", "#376092"],
    legend: true
  },

  marks: [
    // --- MODELED LAYER (Blue) ---
    layersInput.includes("Modeled") ? Plot.areaY(filteredMod, Plot.binX(
      { y: "sum" },
      {
        x: metricInfo.col,
        fy: "Stop_Name",
        weight: "boarding_weight",
        thresholds: 50,
        curve: "basis",
        fill: "#376092",
        fillOpacity: 0.5,
        sort: { fy: null }
      }
    )) : null,

    layersInput.includes("Modeled") ? Plot.lineY(filteredMod, Plot.binX(
      { y: "sum" },
      {
        x: metricInfo.col,
        fy: "Stop_Name",
        weight: "boarding_weight",
        thresholds: 50,
        curve: "basis",
        stroke: "#376092",
        strokeWidth: 1.5
      }
    )) : null,

    // --- OBSERVED LAYER (Green) ---
    layersInput.includes("Observed") ? Plot.areaY(filteredObs, Plot.binX(
      { y: "sum" },
      {
        x: metricInfo.col,
        fy: "Stop_Name",
        weight: "boarding_weight",
        thresholds: 50,
        curve: "basis",
        fill: "#77933c",
        fillOpacity: 0.5,
        sort: { fy: null }
      }
    )) : null,

    layersInput.includes("Observed") ? Plot.lineY(filteredObs, Plot.binX(
      { y: "sum" },
      {
        x: metricInfo.col,
        fy: "Stop_Name",
        weight: "boarding_weight",
        thresholds: 50,
        curve: "basis",
        stroke: "#77933c",
        strokeWidth: 1.5
      }
    )) : null,

    // --- SHARED BASELINE ---
    Plot.ruleY([0], { stroke: "#e5e7eb", strokeWidth: 1 }),

    // --- MEDIANS ---
    layersInput.includes("Modeled") ? Plot.ruleX(filteredMod, Plot.groupZ(
      { x: "median" },
      {
        x: metricInfo.col,
        fy: "Stop_Name",
        weight: "boarding_weight",
        stroke: "#376092",
        strokeWidth: 2,
        strokeDasharray: "4,2",
        tip: {
          format: {
            x: (d) => `Median: ${d.toFixed(2)} ${metricInput.includes("Time") ? "min" : "mi"}`,
            fy: false,
            weight: false
          },
          fill: "white",
          stroke: "#374151",
          anchor: "bottom"
      }
      }
    )) : null,

    layersInput.includes("Observed") ? Plot.ruleX(filteredObs, Plot.groupZ(
      { x: "median" },
      {
        x: metricInfo.col,
        fy: "Stop_Name",
        weight: "boarding_weight",
        stroke: "#77933c",
        strokeWidth: 2,
        strokeDasharray: "4,2",
        tip: {
          format: {
            x: (d) => `Median: ${d.toFixed(2)} ${metricInput.includes("Time") ? "min" : "mi"}`,
            fy: false,
            weight: false
          },
          fill: "white",
          stroke: "#374151",
          anchor: "bottom"
      }
      }
    )) : null
  ]
})
```
